rho_reference.binary_or_process: Each selected price report records one process running both IC and rho arms; binary_blake3 is shared by those arms. The strong walk is a separate same-target cross-check, not the substituted rho arm.
rho_reference.gae_band_basis: Both full arms were timed in one process and all native operations are inside those intervals, as frozen PROTOCOL.md states; the unpriced count is zero, so adding 0, 0.1 or 1 GAE per unpriced operation leaves each measured S unchanged. Count-only model readings remain lower bounds.
rho_reference.protocol: Frozen v7 PROTOCOL.md: same-process signed-Frobenius rho on each public target, cross-checked against the strong signed-Frobenius walk on 48 matching targets.
rho_reference.unit: recorded S per sqrt(subgroup order), both arms from the same process
